description: When the caller flags thin evidence, every signal must be marked confidence low rather than rounded up to medium.

rubric.condition: With thin_evidence true in the input, every item in the signals array has confidence exactly equal to the string low.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring "confidence": "high".
The output contains the literal key name confidence at least 3 times, one per signal.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 5 — the honesty rule that stops thin evidence being laundered into a usable claim.
